It responds most to light fluffy small dogs and to wolf, kuvasz and Appenzeller faces looking at the camera. It is weak when the dog is small or far away in the scene, seen whole-body at a distance, or when the face is uniformly reddish-brown, so the eyes and nose have little contrast. Compared with the similar units, it prefers large, frontal, high-contrast faces over the dog's overall body, coat texture or distant views.
